lessons.title: Getting started – A talented artist
objectives: Gain an overview of the topic 'Music' and key vocabulary related to musical talents and instruments;
Understand and use vocabulary to talk about musical idols;
Identify compound sentences, to-infinitives, and bare infinitives in context.

Develop communicative fluency and active listening;
Be collaborative and supportive in pair work and teamwork;
Actively join in class activities.
Personal Qualities:
Develop a positive attitude toward diverse music genres;
Appreciate the inspiring role of music in daily life.

3: Use AI tools and streaming platforms to search for artist profiles, song catalogs, and musical genres.

lessons.title: Language – Stress in two-syllable words & Compound sentences, To-infinitive / Bare infinitive
lessons.short_title: Stress in two-syllable words & Compound sentences, To-infinitive / Bare infinitive
objectives: Pronounce two-syllable words with correct stress patterns (nouns/adjectives vs. verbs);
Understand and use lexical items related to music and live shows;
Use coordinating conjunctions (and, but, or, so) to form compound sentences;
Use to-infinitives and bare infinitives correctly after specific verbs.
Core Competences:
Develop word stress discrimination, sentence combining accuracy, and grammatical precision;
Work in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:
Appreciate music's cultural role and cultivate independent study habits.
Digital & AI Competences:
3: Use AI tools, digital dictionaries, and pronunciation applications to verify stress patterns in two-syllable words.
MR2: Practice using educational AI tools to generate compound sentences and verify verb-infinitive patterns.

lessons.title: Writing – A blog post about an experience at a music event

Write a structured 120-word personal blog post sharing experiences at a music festival or live concert.

Develop descriptive writing, chronological narrative structuring, and peer editing skills;
Work collaboratively.

Cultivate creative expression and uphold academic honesty.

2: Maintain personal voice, declare AI assistance transparently, and submit the Student AI Declaration Form.
